subject.title: backup create stalls on large installations (4GB+ .openclaw dir)

question: Should OpenClaw solve this large-backup failure with native smart/custom exclusions, with conservative full-backup reliability and progress/error handling, or with a split path that lands reliability first and backup-scope policy later?
rationale: The remaining fix changes public backup CLI behavior and restore-safety policy, and the existing candidate PR is open, conflicting, and labeled as needing proof and maintainer review.

options.title: Review or replace linked exclude PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 as the candidate direction, but require a clean rebase, compatibility/security review, and real large-state backup proof before merge.

options.title: Keep full backups conservative
options.body: Reject smart/default exclusions for now and instead require progress, clear error handling, and cleanup behavior while preserving all state by default.

options.title: Split policy from mechanics
options.body: Land a narrow reliability fix first for clear failure/progress/temp cleanup, then decide exclude-pattern CLI surface separately.

recommendation.title: Review or replace linked exclude PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 as the candidate direction, but require a clean rebase, compatibility/security review, and real large-state backup proof before merge.
